palette: deep graphite + phosphor mint + electric coral + banknote cyan + warm terminal white
typography: monospaced account labels paired with large rounded humanist verdicts, signal underlines, status chips, and terminal seals
composition: one transaction signal enters a routing console, splits into possession-model channels, and resolves in vertically separated account terminals
surface: dark etched circuits, luminous account rails, square terminal windows, waveform ticks, and no document or card metaphors
motion: the same lock-transfer-withdrawal packet travels through competing ownership channels; verdict terminals light only after the controlling model is selected
transition: a horizontal signal sweep clears the console while preserving account endpoints and actor colors
